## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: low volatility (Vol: 17.5%) and broad participation (Breadth: 6/8 sectors positive), supporting risk appetite and cyclicals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Construction & REIT leading: TKFEN (1W: +36.87% | 1M: +57.50%) ABOVE TREND and EKGYO (sector contributors). Banking also strong on rebounds: YKBNK (1W: +9.74% | 1M: -9.52%) RECOVERY, AKBNK (1W: +9.42% | 1M: -8.42%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Heavy Industry weak: EREGL (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -6.25%) BELOW TREND, VESTL (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.87%) BELOW TREND. Technology & Telecom lagging: KONTR (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +36.87% | 1M: +57.50%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +12.93% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY, TUPRS (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +11.28% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY, YKBNK (1W: +9.74% | 1M: -9.52%) RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND, EREGL (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -6.25%) BELOW TREND, DOHOL (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -0.49%) BELOW TREND, KRDMD (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +5.43%) CORRECTION, PETKM (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High upside momentum: TKFEN (1W: +36.87% | 1M: +57.50%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +12.93% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY, TUPRS (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum concentrated in KONTR (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banks are staging a recovery on broad risk-on flows: AKBNK (1W: +9.42% | 1M: -8.42%) RECOVERY, GARAN (1W: +3.17% | 1M: -5.51%) RECOVERY, ISCTR (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -14.46%) RECOVERY, VAKBN (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -5.24%) RECOVERY — trade selective exposure to rate-sensitive names.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed: autos/defense show selective strength while steel remains weak — FROTO (1W: +1.83% | 1M: -5.90%) RECOVERY, ASELS (1W: +4.81% | 1M: -7.64%) RECOVERY, but EREGL (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -6.25%) BELOW TREND and KRDMD (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +5.43%) CORRECTION warrant caution.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy leading the rally: TUPRS (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +15.29%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +11.69%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND is an outlier.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Overweight cyclicals and construction/energy names on the RISK-ON backdrop, add selective bank exposure on recoveries; trim underperforming heavy industrials and weak tech names (KONTR, EREGL) and take profits into strength.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TKFEN (1W: +36.87% | 1M: +57.50%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation, TUPRS (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND on oil/earnings sensitivity, AKBNK (1W: +9.42% | 1M: -8.42%) RECOVERY for bank flows, KONTR (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND for volatility-driven opportunities.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Construction & REIT, Banking & Finance, and Energy & Chemicals for leadership validation and flow confirmation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor XU100 for a consolidated breakout continuation vs a pullback to the 50-day average; primary near-term catalysts are CBRT commentary, domestic CPI prints, FX moves and oil price direction, plus corporate earnings and inflows/outflows.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON market with low volatility and broad sector participation; construction and energy lead while heavy industry and tech lag. Favor tactical overweight in construction, selective banks and energy; watch KONTR and EREGL as downside risk/mean-reversion trade candidates.
